statement: I, Andrew Miller, reviewed the generated WAFT-validation runtime license and notice inventory with SHA256 9f5b05c4281c66963842c20eea646a19a0f534fa95e40e39fe9cc6560345bab8, covering the conda base (python 3.12, conda-pack, setuptools and the transitive system libraries) and the pip-installed export stack (PyTorch CPU, torchvision, numpy, scipy, onnx, onnxruntime CPU, safetensors, timm and their transitive dependencies), each bound to its own licence and notice evidence. I approve this exact runtime inventory for the WAFT export/validation run. The pinned WAFT source is BSD-3-Clause; the WAFT checkpoint is operator-supplied and its file-level licence remains unknown -- this approval covers the packed runtime only, not the checkpoint, and no upstream source or checkpoint is carried in the package.
